_about: Public-domain Francis of Assisi (1181/2-1226) in English for the Word Hoard: his own writings in Paschal Robinson's translation (Philadelphia, 1906), in the version by a Religious of the Order (Washbourne, catalogued 1882), in Constance de la Warr's (about 1907) and Reginald Balfour's Seraphic Keepsake, and the Little Flowers, the fourteenth-century Franciscan collection about him, in Abby Langdon Alger's translation (Boston, 1887) and in the Upton version revised by Thomas Okey (London, 1899), all from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-17 by lane A, round 25 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Translators recorded per item where the title page names one; every printing dated or catalogued before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

francis-writings-robinson: The Writings of Saint Francis of Assisi, newly translated by Father Paschal Robinson (Philadelphia: Dolphin Press, MCMVI)
francis-works-religious: Works of the Seraphic Father St. Francis of Assisi, translated by a Religious of the Order (London: R. Washbourne; catalogued 1882)
francis-writings-de-la-warr: The Writings of St Francis of Assisi, by Constance, Countess de la Warr (London: Burns & Oates; catalogued 1907)
francis-seraphic-keepsake: The Seraphic Keepsake, written for Brother Leo by Saint Francis, set forth in English by Reginald Balfour (London: Burns & Oates; catalogued 1905)
francis-little-flowers-alger: The Little Flowers of Saint Francis of Assisi (a fourteenth-century Franciscan collection about him), tr. Abby Langdon Alger (Boston: Roberts Brothers, 1887)
francis-little-flowers-okey: The Little Flowers of Saint Francis (about him), the Upton translation revised by Thomas Okey, illustrated by Paul Woodroffe (London: Kegan Paul, MDCCCXCIX)

_alternates.francis-canticle-sun: The Canticle of the Sun (New York: Duffield, 1907), a leaflet with a garbled title page
_alternates.francis-copies: Other copies of Robinson, de la Warr and Balfour
_alternates.francis-little-flowers-copies: Alger 1898, Okey 1905, T. W. Arnold (Chatto & Windus, 1908), Everyman (1910-1927)

_excluded.francis-about: Lives and legends about him: Celano, the Three Companions, the Mirror of Perfection, Sabatier, Chesterton, Chalippe
_excluded.francis-ccel-flowers: CCEL ugolino/flowers: Heritage Press, Hudleston revision, post-1929
_excluded.francis-late: Peter Pauper and Burns Oates & Washbourne printings after 1929
